enum Flagged {
    true_(true),
    false_(false);

    final bool value;
    const Flagged(this.value);

    static Flagged fromValue(bool value) => Flagged.values.firstWhere((e) => e.value == value);
}

enum Label {
    work("work"),
    personal("personal");

    final String value;
    const Label(this.value);

    static Label fromValue(String value) => Label.values.firstWhere((e) => e.value == value);
}

enum Priority {
    $_1(1),
    $_2(2),
    $_3(3);

    final int value;
    const Priority(this.value);

    static Priority fromValue(int value) => Priority.values.firstWhere((e) => e.value == value);
}

enum Score {
    $_1(1),
    $_2_5(2.5),
    $_3(3);

    final double value;
    const Score(this.value);

    static Score fromValue(double value) => Score.values.firstWhere((e) => e.value == value);
}

class Ticket {
    final Flagged? flagged;
    final Label? label;
    final Priority priority;
    final List<Priority>? relatedPriorities;
    final Score? score;
    final TicketSeverity? severity;

    Ticket({
        this.flagged,
        this.label,
        required this.priority,
        this.relatedPriorities,
        this.score,
        this.severity,
    });

    factory Ticket.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
        return Ticket(
            flagged: json["flagged"] != null ? Flagged.fromValue(json["flagged"] as bool) : null,
            label: json["label"] != null ? Label.fromValue(json["label"] as String) : null,
            priority: Priority.fromValue(json["priority"] as int),
            relatedPriorities: (json["relatedPriorities"] as List<dynamic>?)?.map((e) => Priority.fromValue(e as int)).toList(),
            score: json["score"] != null ? Score.fromValue((json["score"] as num).toDouble()) : null,
            severity: json["severity"] != null ? TicketSeverity.fromValue(json["severity"] as int) : null,
        );
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
        return {
            "flagged": flagged?.value,
            "label": label?.value,
            "priority": priority.value,
            "relatedPriorities": relatedPriorities?.map((e) => e.value).toList(),
            "score": score?.value,
            "severity": severity?.value,
        };
    }
}

enum TicketSeverity {
    $_1(1),
    $_2(2),
    $_3(3);

    final int value;
    const TicketSeverity(this.value);

    static TicketSeverity fromValue(int value) => TicketSeverity.values.firstWhere((e) => e.value == value);
}
